notes: Samsung prints Dimension & Weight as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH; mapped to height/width/depth accordingly. Samsung never publishes a crease shape (teardrop/U) for any Flip, so hinge.crease is null throughout. hinge.max_angle_deg left null: Samsung states Flex Mode working angles, not a maximum hinge angle. Samsung publishes TWO folded thicknesses: 17.3mm at the hinge and 15.4mm at the 'Sagging' (tapered) end; 15.4 recorded as closed.depth and 17.3 as depth_at_hinge. Open depth likewise printed as a range '7.2mm - 6.9mm (Screen)'; 7.2 recorded, 6.9 is the screen-only figure. Neither display's refresh rate is stated in the 2020 press release, so refresh_hz is null (this generation predates Samsung quoting refresh rates for the Flip). Frame/back materials not stated in the press release - left null; UTG is the foldable main-display glass, recorded in cover_glass for want of a better field.
